teaser: The site as an inbox that starts empty: decide fast before reading, mark slowly while reading, build a graph you own, and sign what you send to the newsroom.
core_idea: With the reader's vault live, the next brief treats the site as an inbox that starts empty: every piece, original or aggregated, waits for a one-tap decision in a fast inbox mode with nothing loaded, and only reading is the slow mode, where marks of six kinds become nodes in a graph the reader owns, connected to the graphs the site publishes for every article; scroll depth, awake time and from-and-to are recorded for the reader and kept as the meter keeps everything, in the browser and the vault; personas each have a key pair so a comment to the newsroom goes down the write-only lane signed with a copy kept; nothing is gamified; and the brief could only be written once the properties of what runs became the constraints to think with.

nodes.label: The constraints are what let me think
nodes.summary: The brief could not be written until the vault ran; five properties of what runs closed the design space enough to think in a morning.

nodes.label: The site is an inbox
nodes.summary: It starts empty; every piece, original or aggregated, waits for a decision; deciding is the work and reading is one of the decisions.

nodes.label: The inbox mode
nodes.summary: With nothing loaded, one tap: read now, read later, not for me, more like this, less like this, comment, move to a persona.

nodes.label: The reading mode
nodes.summary: The piece open, the pane about it: its graph, the reader's marks, the decisions, the cost.

nodes.label: No gamification
nodes.summary: A decision is offered where the reader would take it, never at the end of a page; a signal the site engineered is not a signal.

nodes.label: Marks of six kinds
nodes.summary: Interesting, great phrase, not sure, fact, evidence, question: each a node with the phrase, the article, the version, the persona and the time.

nodes.label: The reader's own graph
nodes.summary: Marks connect to the public article graphs; meaning comes from connectivity; the graph is worth more the more it is used.

nodes.label: The free signals
nodes.summary: Scroll depth as read or glanced, time while awake, from and to, the decisions; kept in the browser and the vault, seen by an agent only through a read key.

nodes.label: Personas with keys
nodes.summary: Disposable, one key pair each; the editor persona comments on everything; a persona can be handed to an agent as a read key to its slice.

nodes.label: The signed lane
nodes.summary: A mark for the newsroom is encrypted to its published key, signed by the persona, copied to the vault; the reply is a new version.

nodes.label: The bet
nodes.summary: The loop closes only if reading with a graph that grows is better than reading without one.

nodes.label: What to build, in order
nodes.summary: Inbox mode on the wire first, the pane about the piece, marks, signals, persona keys, the signed lane, the views, an experiment per feature.

quotes.text: Deciding is the work; reading is one of the decisions.
Ship first, think second, and do not pretend the thinking could have come first.
quotes.why: The order the feedback loop runs in.

quotes.text: I am not highlighting any more. I am building my graph.
